question_sw: Mgodi wetu unalipa mrahaba wa madini kwa kiwango gani kwa mwaka?
why: THE ATTESTED DEFECT. The N3 probe spelled it mrahaba; the list has mrabaha; zero phrases matched and the model refused on its own judgement, which R11 exists so we never depend on.

question_sw: Ushuru wa forohda kwa mzigo kutoka Dubai ni asilimia ngapi?
why: d/h transposition, the same operation as mrabaha->mrahaba applied to the customs term.

question_sw: Nikiuza dhabahu ninayochimba, naliparoyalty kiasi gani?
why: h/b transposition. Note royalty ya dhahabu already has its dh->z variant (zahabu) -- the family LOOKS covered while carrying no metathesis form at all.

question_sw: Kutoa mzigo badnari wanadai ushuru kiasi gani?
why: n/d transposition -- a phone-keyboard slip rather than a dialect form, which is a real source of variation and one nothing in the suite models.

question_sw: Ushuru wa stepmu kwa mkataba wa kampuni ni kiasi gani?
why: m/p transposition. SPECIMEN CORRECTED before freezing: the first draft said "hati ya kuuza nyumba", which contains the OOC land-sale cue -- the row was refused via "kuuza nyumba" and never tested the variant at all.

question_sw: Nimeuza kiwajna changu kwa faida, nalipa kodi gani?
why: n/j transposition on the land term. uza kiwanja is deliberately the NARROW form (R17 step 4); the variant defeats the narrowing entirely.

question_sw: Kuna ushuru wa stampu kwa hati za kampuni?
why: e->a under English 'stamp' influence -- the most likely of all 32 to occur in real traffic, because the English source word is what a code-switching user has in mind.

question_sw: Watu wa foradha watanitoza kiasi gani kwa mzigo wangu?
why: o->a in the unstressed syllable.

question_sw: Kodi ya medini kwa mchimbaji mdogo ni kiasi gani?
why: a->e. Deliberately NOT madeni, which is a real in-scope word (debts) -- see oh_20, the collision this axis creates.

question_sw: Mrabaho wa mawe ya thamani unalipwa kwa TRA au kwa wizara?
why: final a->o. SPECIMEN CORRECTED before freezing: the first draft said "tanzanite", itself an OOC cue, so the row was refused on that and never tested the variant.

question_sw: Uthamani wa ardhi yangu unafanywa na nani kwa ajili ya kodi?
why: i->a, pulling it toward thamani (value), a word that genuinely exists -- so the variant is not obviously a typo to a reader.

question_sw: Ushuru wa bema ya malipo ni asilimia ngapi?
why: i->e. Insurance premium levy is OOC; WCF questions using bima are IN SCOPE -- see oh_23.

question_sw: Ushuru wa ati ya kiwanja unalipwaje?
why: h-dropping, extremely common in typed Swahili. 'ati' is also a substring of ordinary words -- see oh_19.

question_sw: Nikiwekeza kwenye soko la isa nalipa kodi gani ya faida?
why: h-dropping. 'isa' is a substring of nisaidie, the single most common opening a real user types -- see oh_18. This pair is the sharpest collision in the set.

question_sw: Mrabah wa madini ya ujenzi unatozwa vipi?
why: final-vowel drop.

question_sw: Kodi ya kuagza bidhaa kutoka China iko asilimia ngapi?
why: syncope of the medial vowel.

question_sw: Ushuru wa huduma wa halmashauri hauwezi kuzidi asilimia ngapi ya mauzo?
why: SERVICE LEVY IS IN SCOPE. An elision cue 'ushur' would match 'ushuru' and refuse this. The OOC list is careful here already -- ushuru wa forodha / wa stempu / wa madini are all context-qualified (R17 step 4) -- and an unqualified elision variant would throw that away in one line.

question_sw: Nisaidie kujua PAYE ya mshahara wa TZS 900,000 kwa mwezi.
why: 'nisaidie' CONTAINS 'isa'. A bare elision variant of hisa refuses the commonest opening a real user types. This is the row that most cheaply proves an unqualified single-syllable variant is unusable.

question_sw: Nina matatizo ya kuwasilisha return ya VAT mwezi huu, nifanyeje?
why: 'matatizo' CONTAINS 'ati'. Same shape as oh_18 on the other elision candidate.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina madeni mengi mwaka huu, je bado nalipa kodi ya mapato?
why: THE COLLISION THE VOWEL AXIS CREATES BY CONSTRUCTION. a->e on madini (minerals) produces madeni, which is not a typo at all -- it is the ordinary Swahili for DEBTS, and a live in-scope corporate-tax question. Any madeni cue refuses real users asking about company debt.
guards_against: madeni as a vowel-variant of madini

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ya madini ina wafanyakazi 30, nalipa SDL kiasi gani?
why: MINING COMPANY, IN-SCOPE OBLIGATION. The topic is mining and the question is SDL, which is squarely in scope. Refusing on the sector rather than the obligation is a whole class of wrong refusal, and it is what a widened madini cue would cause.

question_sw: Duka langu la dhahabu linahitaji mashine ya EFD?
why: RETAIL SALE of gold is ordinary in-scope business (EFD/VAT); the mineral ROYALTY is not. Same noun, opposite verdicts, decided by the obligation.

question_sw: WCF ni kama bima ya ajali kazini? Mwajiri analipa asilimia ngapi?
why: WCF IS IN SCOPE and users reach for 'bima ya ajali' to describe it -- the routing cue list uses exactly that phrase. Insurance premium levy is OOC. Any bima variant risks refusing the levy this project actually covers.

question_sw: Namlipa mwandishi mrabaha kwa kitabu chake, nakata kodi ya zuio asilimia ngapi?
why: THE BOUNDARY THAT MAKES THIS AXIS DANGEROUS. royalties_wht_rate is a LOCKED FACT (15% default, 10% film, 5% sports bodies) -- royalty withholding is IN SCOPE. Only MINING royalty is OOC. 'mrabaha' is currently a BARE OOC cue, so this may already be refused today; the offline validity check classifies it rather than assuming. Either way, adding a bare mrahaba doubles an existing over-breadth instead of closing a gap.

question_sw: Kiwanja changu cha kiwanda kina wafanyakazi watano, nasajili OSHA?
why: 'kiwanja' as PREMISES, not as a parcel being sold. The list narrows correctly to uza kiwanja / nunua kiwanja; a bare metathesis variant kiwajna would not inherit that narrowing.

question_sw: Ghala langu liko karibu na bandari, je nasajili mahali pa kazi OSHA?
why: The word appears; the obligation is workplace registration. ushuru wa bandari is the OOC form and it is context-qualified -- a bare badnari would not be.

question_sw: Nikiagiza mashine ya EFD kutoka TRA, utaratibu wa kusajili ni upi?
why: 'nikiagiza' is a BARE cue in the current OOC list, and here it governs an EFD machine from TRA -- entirely in scope. A pre-existing over-breadth the elision axis would widen further.

question_sw: Kampuni yetu ina wanahisa watano na haijaorodheshwa popote, kodi ya mapato ni asilimia ngapi?
why: R17 already measured that bare 'hisa' refuses 7 real gate questions, and ecb61b3 narrowed soko la hisa for exactly this. Re-probed here because the elision axis reintroduces the same exposure by a different route.

question_sw: Nimepokea hati ya usajili wa kampuni kutoka BRELA, hatua inayofuata ni ipi?
why: BRELA certificate, in scope. ushuru wa hati / hati ya kiwanja are the OOC forms and both are qualified.

question_sw: Thamani ya mauzo yangu imefika milioni 210 mwaka huu, nasajili VAT?
why: 'thamani' (value) is ordinary in-scope vocabulary and oh_11's uthamani variant sits one letter from it. tathmini ya ardhi / thamani ya ardhi are the OOC forms, both qualified by ardhi.

question_sw: Kampuni yangu inahitaji muhuri na stempu ya kampuni kwa nyaraka za BRELA?
why: A company STAMP (the physical seal) is not stamp DUTY. stampu/stepmu variants attach to the object, not the levy, and this is the question they would wrongly catch.

question_sw: Ushuru wa mafunzo (SDL) kwa kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 12 ni asilimia ngapi?
why: Second ushuru row deliberately: SDL is also commonly called 'ushuru wa mafunzo'. One in-scope casualty per risky token is an existence proof; two across different obligations shows the exposure is not a single unlucky phrasing.
